rules.notes: 0.005% on the amount invested. Statutory, levied on purchase only. Law: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Schedule I Article 56A(a), issue of security other than debenture: 0.005%; a mutual fund unit is a security (s.2(23A), SCRA s.2(h)(id)). Read 2026-10-28; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-statutory-charge-rates.md row 6.

0.001% on redemption of equity-oriented schemes only. Statutory. The scheme attribute comes from the instrument profile, which is why the broker's mutual fund card requires one: with no profile the variable is unset, this rule is quietly skipped, and the gap is recorded as NO_INSTRUMENT_PROFILE rather than passing unnoticed. Law: Finance (No. 2) Act, 2004 s.98 Table Sl. 5, sale of a unit of an equity-oriented fund to the Mutual Fund: 0.001 per cent (Finance Act 2013 s.135(v)). Read 2026-10-28; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-statutory-charge-rates.md row 3.
